title: Abstinence and Integration
excerpt: Only in abstinence can we observe ourselves in the nude. We may find our bare being ugly — the point is to see it, and then integrate.

sections.kicker: Side note in the original: "this has been the theme lately especially cuz leo reminded us today about how we stop doing stuff but then fulfill the void thru other means"
body: halted vices amongst many other things only for it to be translated into me making pb n j sandwiches at night.

foolish humans. escaping the reality of our being. so EAGER to be everywhere but HERE. so EAGER to run away and ultimately imprison ourselves in illusion. in the dizzying and deafening merry go round. as of lately the deafening is so loud it irritates every fiber of my being. it disgusts me. its a reminder of a place i used to be in. a reminder of a place only sages discuss.

we must starve. the bible says we must fast. dont eat breakfast (not really but u must understand otherwise we are speaking different languages. context is everything). only in abstinence can we observe ourselves in the nude. in the bare wholeness of our true being. we may find our bare being to be ugly and repulsive. but the point is to know. to see. to be wise. and then to ultimately integrate.

anyways. i speculate somewhere in this conversation holds a key hint to the answer of the Great Question (my personal question). how does one shake hands with God so that he can open your eyes and you can behold the true nature of this mysterious existence. i believe i have in many forms in the past. but i'm not certain of how i got there. i need to come here and make that a statement to remind myself of the gift that was granted to me. as i fear i may forget these essential truths of reality while allowing my mind to conform to what i think is necessary for now. the point is i CANNOT EVER forget. and at some point i MUST figure out HOW.

i can assure you that i only conclude certainties from certainties. either i speculate from the fantasies of my foolish mind, or i CONCLUDE from what is presented in front of me. my point is, i do not present such bold claims for no reason. in fact, as i like to say, **i am more skeptical of my own beliefs than anyone will ever be to my own.** if i claim something as vast as the nature of this world to be true, its because i am CERTAIN and have dedicated and experienced too much to conclude such a thing.

i feel i must justify my far out claims cuz i think i wont be posting for a minute. so i feel the need to say this as a disclaimer for anyone who may hope to find any truths when looking at my explorations.
quote: if it doesn't make sense, dw it doesn't matter
if you are listening, it should only be for a good reason
nothing else. it should be to serve God.
